name: Jaqueline Vanek : The Mystery of Hrafndís // Art Exhibition
description:
I’m delighted to invite you to the opening of my upcoming exhibition, presenting a selection of works from my series “The Mystery of Hrafndís”, on August 28th at Brewgata in Oslo. I’ll be there throughout the evening!

Accompanying the exhibition will be…

🎵 At 21:00, Villjuvet performing a live set of dark ambient, drone, and noise. A floating moody sound collage!

🎧 From 22:00, my partner in crime Marius Bowitz will take over with a blackgaze and post-metal DJ set.

This opening is especially meaningful because I’ll also be celebrating my birthday (which is the day before) 🖤!!! As a little birthday gift, all artworks will be available at a special discounted price for this night only, so if anyone is interested in my artwork, this will be the perfect opportunity.

📍 Brewgata 5, Oslo
🗓️ August 28, 2026
🖤 Exhibition Opening: 18:00
🎵 Villjuvet Live: 21:00
🎧 Marius Bowitz DJ Set: 22:00

Free admission. Everyone is welcome.
See you there 🖤
